title: System status

health.healthyHint: Vehicle data is being read and stored normally.
health.degradedHint: Data is still being read, but storage is falling behind or the database is unreachable.
health.downHint: No successful read from the vehicle feed in the last 30 seconds.

loadError: Could not load the system status.

spool.label: Pending spool batches
